claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, amoxapine is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated norepinephrine reuptake inhibition; any modest antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a tricyclic antidepressant class effect (membrane/lysosomal and monoamine-receptor-mediated toxicity) rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
